items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 11:118:1
items.html:
Every surrounding light is Ehyeh of Yudin, therefore Tzelem [image] equals Ehyeh in gematria: For the name Ehyeh means, “I am destined to give birth,” as is written in the Zohar (Part 3, page 65b).
And therefore the matter of every inner light is that the phase within it is destined to show its revelation in the future, as is known; therefore it is Ehyeh of Yudin, since the entirety of the future is imprinted within it. And this is similar to a fetus in its mother’s womb, which then has no revelation at all, yet it is revealed and known to all that a complete Partzuf is destined to be revealed from it. And this is what he means, “that I am destined to give birth.”
